connector.name: KeepMySubs
connector.registryDescription: Manage your KeepMySubs subscriptions, spend, renewals, and bills from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Hosted at keepmysubs.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.keepmysubs, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KMS_API_KEY
env.description: Your KeepMySubs API key. Create one at https://keepmysubs.com/dashboard/settings (Settings → API keys), or run `kms auth login`.

env.name: KMS_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API host (defaults to https://keepmysubs.com). Rarely needed.
